app_fee.value: Clemson's graduate school charges no application fee for any graduate program.
app_fee.quote: There is no fee to apply to graduate programs at Clemson University.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee is charged, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no fee to apply to graduate programs at Clemson University.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule; each program sets its own.

toefl_min.value: The English page's minimum table extracted as split fragments, so no university TOEFL minimum is recorded. Programs quote their own minimums.

ielts_min.value: The English page's minimum table extracted as split fragments, so no university IELTS minimum is recorded. Programs quote their own minimums.

english_waiver.value: For an English-medium Indian degree, the applicant checks the WHED database; if the institution is listed with English as its sole language of instruction, the test is waived. Letters and certificates are not accepted.
english_waiver.quote: You may verify whether your institution meets this requirement by looking up your institution in the IAU WHED World Higher Education Database.

also.quote: A foreign college or university that provides instruction solely in English and is equivalent to a U.S. bachelor’s or graduate degree can satisfy the English proficiency requirement.
No other documentation (e.g., letters, language certificates, school websites) may be used.

notes: The English page's minimum score table (TOEFL iBT, IELTS, Duolingo, PTE) extracted as split fragments and was not used.
